newsitem.title: USA: Datatrend says '96 loss was $2.6 million.
newsitem.headline: Datatrend says '96 loss was $2.6 million.

text.p: Datatrend Services Inc said Friday it incurred a loss of $2.6 million for 1996, mostly from the write-down of inventory.
The company said in a press statement some of the written-down inventory was "obsolete or unrecoverable" and some reflected "declining prices and rapid technological change in the industry."
The loss came on sales of $39.1 million, compared with $29.3 million in 1995.
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment further.
